candidate.user_submission: The child is 18 months old. The child has cough or difficult breathing. Cough has been there for 3 days. I counted the breaths for one full minute while the child was calm. Respiratory rate is 45 breaths per minute. There is no chest indrawing. There is no stridor when the child is calm. Wheezing is present. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. There is no diarrhoea. There is no ear problem. The child does not have fever. Pulse oximeter was not available. No recurrent wheeze.
